source_reuse.method: wrapper translation unit includes the existing source after renaming its host main; invoke original target symbol with original arguments
source_reuse.required_SASS_equality: normalized complete target function instructions and register/shared/local resource identity equal to diagnostic-wgmma-e4m3-v2 baseline; changed codegen requires separate review

outputs.persist: every output as index, decimal double and exact float32 uint32 bits; never only first differences or histogram
outputs.initialization: output doubles=0xff poison and stamp=0xff before the single launch
outputs.completion: CUDA launch and event completion succeed; all output doubles finite and equal to their own float32 roundtrip; all stamp fields overwritten; no positive minimum duration or all-SM coverage requirement
outputs.comparison: each value compared with mathematical_expected16384 only as diagnostic difference, never accepted accuracy tolerance
outputs.summary: difference_count, finite_count, min,max and distinct-value counts independently recomputed from complete values

reference.derivation: 8192 iterations *16 MMA per chain *32 dot products *(1/16)^2 =16384
reference.semantic_limit: not asserted as a mandatory result of the hardware long FP8 accumulator; retained solely to characterize the previous mismatch

execution.platform: ROMEO valid single-GPU Slurm allocation, CUDA12.9 sm90a
execution.locks: existing suite/output lock and separate GPU UUID lock with active process registry
execution.snapshot: freeze wrapper, included source and recursive headers, contract, runner, auditor, compiler/toolchain and old-source/SASS references before any target execution
execution.resume: completed or numerical-difference collection never automatically rerun; interrupted process requires confirmed cleanup before new attempt
execution.failure: CUDA failure, incomplete output, NaN/Inf/poison, malformed identity or mismatched SASS remains a rejected diagnostic; finite differing output is retained as evidence and grants no correctness/performance qualification

followup: If finite mismatch appears, examine its pattern and plan bounded length comparison separately; if exact pass, next hypothesis is original launch sequence/occasional behavior. Neither followup is implicitly run by this profile.
